name: valslide-body-saw
instructions:
1. Assume a plank position with your feet on valslides.
2. Push your forearms into the floor as you propel your feet backwards.
3. Pull yourself forward using your lats while maintaining a plank position.
4. Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
starting_position: 1. Assume a plank position with your feet on valslides. 2. Push your forearms into the floor as you propel your feet backwards.
